"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"U.S. aid should be based on the model of the Millennium Challenge Corporation, requiring foreign governments to compete for funds by demonstrating respect for the rule of law, free enterprise, and measurable results.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration's cultural agenda has limited the effectiveness of U.S. foreign aid by attempting to impose legalized abortion and a homosexual rights agenda on foreign countries, especially in Africa.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group will reverse the exclusion of faith-based groups from grants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group will encourage more involvement by effective aid organizations.",
